tree.heading: Federal land
tree.text: The term “Federal land” means any land managed by a Federal land management agency.

tree.heading: Federal land management agency
tree.text: The term “Federal land management agency” means—

children.text: the United States Fish and Wildlife Service;

tree.heading: Road or trail
tree.text: The term “road or trail” means a road or trail designated by 1 or more of the Secretaries for public use.

children.text: the Secretary of Agriculture, acting through the Chief of the Forest Service;
the Secretary of the Interior; and
the Secretary of the Army, acting through the Assistant Secretary of the Army for Civil Works.

notes.text: Short TitlePub. L. 117–114, § 1, Apr. 29, 2022, 136 Stat. 1175, provided that: “This Act [enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘Modernizing Access to Our Public Land Act’.”
